items.t: My phone keeps freezing.
Have you tried turning it off and on again?
The Wi-Fi is down again.
I'm at two percent. Do you have a charger?
items.z: 我手机只剩百分之二了，你有充电器吗？

items.t: Can you send me the link?
I'm locked out of my account.
I need to reset my password.
My screen is cracked. How much would it cost to fix?
items.z: 我屏幕碎了，修一下要多少钱？

items.t: The app keeps crashing every time I open it.
items.z: 这个 App 一打开就闪退。

items.t: Did you get my text?
You're on mute.
Can everyone see my screen?
items.z: 大家能看到我的屏幕吗？

items.t: Let me share my screen real quick.
Sorry, my internet's been spotty today.
items.z: 抱歉，我今天网络时断时续。

items.t: I'll drop the link in the chat.
items.z: 我把链接发到聊天框里。

items.t: Can you AirDrop me those photos?
items.z: 能把那些照片隔空投送给我吗？

items.t: I'm running out of storage.
Turn on Do Not Disturb before the movie.
items.z: 看电影前打开勿扰模式。

items.t: My laptop's fan is really loud lately.
items.z: 我笔记本的风扇最近特别响。

items.t: Have you backed up your files?
